papers.title: Uncertainty quantification in operational modal analysis with stochastic subspace identification: Validation and applications
papers.first_author_affiliation: University of Leuven (KU Leuven), Department of Civil Engineering, Kasteelpark Arenberg 40, B-3001 Leuven, Belgium

corresponding_authors.name: Edwin Reynders
corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Leuven (KU Leuven), Department of Civil Engineering, Kasteelpark Arenberg 40, B-3001 Leuven, Belgium

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于结构动力学中的不确定性量化，与生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No surrogate modeling for FEA, no implant or biomechanics context, and no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 在运行模态分析中量化识别不确定性，提高结构健康监测可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 采用随机子空间识别方法，结合不确定性传播理论进行模态参数不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 通过数值和实验案例验证了所提方法在模态参数不确定性估计上的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 使用数值仿真和实际桥梁振动数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify uncertainties in modal parameter estimates from operational modal analysis for reliable structural health monitoring.
summary_en.method: A stochastic subspace identification framework is employed with uncertainty propagation to estimate confidence intervals of modal parameters.
summary_en.result: The method provides accurate uncertainty bounds validated on both numerical and experimental bridge vibration data.
summary_en.validation: Validation via numerical simulations and field measurements on a bridge structure.

papers.title: Comparison of the torsional fretting behavior of three porous titanium coatings for biomedical applications
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Oral Diseases, West China Hospital of Stomatology, Sichuan University, Chengdu 610041, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Haiyang Yu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Oral Diseases, West China Hospital of Stomatology, Sichuan University, Chengdu 610041, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了三种多孔钛涂层的扭转微动行为，但与应力遮挡、LPBF制造或疲劳性能无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较三种多孔钛涂层在扭转微动下的摩擦行为。
summary_zh.method: 通过等离子喷涂和烧结制备三种涂层，进行扭转微动测试。
summary_zh.result: 不同涂层的摩擦系数和磨损机制存在差异。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜和磨损形貌分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the torsional fretting behavior of three different porous titanium coatings for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Three porous titanium coatings were fabricated via plasma spraying and sintering, and subjected to torsional fretting tests.
summary_en.result: The friction coefficients and wear mechanisms varied among the coatings, with differences in debris and surface damage.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through SEM observation and wear scar analysis.
